name: tpl-precedence-2-goal
task: Do not drop the key while the door is closed until the door has been opened once. Reach the goal.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: key_lost is by definition only true when the key is dropped while the door is still closed, so the ban is a plain hard Absence(key_lost), and Existence(at_goal) is the required goal.

texts: The agent never drops the key while the door is closed before the door has been opened once.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u2
REJECTING_STATES: u1
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&key_lost) -> u1
(u0, at_goal&!key_lost) -> u2
(u0, at_goal&key_lost) -> u1
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&key_lost, u1) -> -10
(u0, at_goal&!key_lost, u2) -> 11
(u0, at_goal&key_lost, u1) -> -10
